# Edit.org

> > Edit.org is an online graphic design platform offering customizable templates and a photo editor for businesses, creators, and professionals.

Edit.org provides a browser-based design tool with thousands of templates for restaurants, beauty salons, posters, book covers, and social media marketing. The platform supports team collaboration, franchise branding, and multi-format content creation without requiring design expertise.

## Key Topics

- Online design tool
- Graphic editor
- Template customization
- Restaurant design & marketing
